content.question: Which value truly needs its own state in this example?

options.text: `fullName` as a third synchronized state value

feedback.correct: `fullName` is derived from the two source values. There is no external system to synchronize.
feedback.incorrect: `fullName` is derived from the two source values. There is no external system to synchronize.

activities.title: Why the extra Effect is a problem

content.title: Why the extra Effect is a problem
content.text:
With the Effect version, a name change can produce:

1. a state update for `firstName` or `lastName`,
2. a render,
3. an Effect run,
4. another state update for `fullName`,
5. another render.

The simpler render-time calculation keeps the data flow direct.

content.title: Move this logic
Event logic is different too

content.question:
Match each task to the right place:

1. Calculate `total = price * quantity`.
2. Respond to a button click that submits a change.
3. Keep a browser timer synchronized with a state value.

feedback.correct: Calculate pure values during render, react directly to user actions in handlers, and use Effects when synchronizing with an external system.
feedback.incorrect: Calculate pure values during render, react directly to user actions in handlers, and use Effects when synchronizing with an external system.

content.question:
A developer says, “Whenever this state changes, I need an Effect.”

What is the better question?

options.text: “What external system are we synchronizing with?”
“Can we make the component re-render four times?”

feedback.correct: A state change alone does not justify an Effect. First identify the external system or side effect that actually needs synchronization.
feedback.incorrect: A state change alone does not justify an Effect. First identify the external system or side effect that actually needs synchronization.

content.title: Forge takeaway & Lesson completion
takeaways: **Mental model:** Render computes UI from data. Event handlers respond to user actions. Effects synchronize with external systems.
**Senior habit:** Before writing `useEffect`, name the external system you are synchronizing with. If you cannot name one, stop and reconsider.
nextSteps: Remove an unnecessary Effect from a derived-value example and classify three pieces of logic as render, event, or synchronization work.
